title: SinCoTrap: A High-Order Locally Corrected Trapezoidal Rule for Periodic Singular Integrals in Arbitrary Dimensions
summary: We present SinCoTrap (Singularity-Corrected Trapezoidal Rule), a high-order locally corrected trapezoidal method for periodic singular integrals in arbitrary dimension $d$ with kernel $|\boldsymbol{x}|^{-s}$, $0<s<d$. The scheme preserves the uniform tensor grid and modifies only a fixed, small stencil of weights near the singularity. For a correction order $p$, the resulting quadrature attains the error rate $O(h^{2p+2+d-s})$.
